newsitem.title: SPAIN: Asturiana stock trading to resume Monday.
newsitem.headline: Asturiana stock trading to resume Monday.

text.p: Spain's stock market watchdog on Friday said it would lift its suspension of trade in shares of zinc producer Asturiana on Monday.
"The CNMV has agreed to lift, with effect of July 14, 1997, the suspension of trade imposed on July 7 on Asturiana de Zinc," the regulator CNMV said in a statement.
The CNMV suspended trading in Asturiana shares on Monday after receiving a request for a bid offer for the zinc producer's shares.

Privately held Glencore submitted a request to acquire an additional 20 percent of Asturiana's shares through a public tender offer of 3,400 pesetas a share. Glencore currently holds a 24.79 percent stake in the company.
